basis: The HS 2022 description names portable automatic data processing machines of not more than 10 kg with a central processing unit, a keyboard and a display.
The HS 2022 description names smartphones for cellular or other wireless networks.

The HS 2022 description names non-cathode-ray-tube monitors designed for use with an automatic data processing machine. The source records are computer monitors; a monitor not designed for computer use would fall under 852859.

Heading 6811 covers articles of cellulose fibre-cement or the like. The 6-digit subheading is not chosen here.
